title: Batch 160 — four new Hebrew source identities and four canonical in-place enrichments
review_method: Manual public web/open inspection of ten accessible Hebrew Chabad.org / BeitChabad bodies. Four new source identities (one telegram, two Sicha transcripts, one letter) and four distinct in-place enrichments were added. Two additional pages were inspected but not enriched because existing propositions already cover the available passage. AID 2987993 returned Internal Error; four alternate public bodies were opened in the same run. No search snippet or title was used as content; no crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text reproduction.

blocked_candidates.reason: The public reader returned Internal Error; no readable body was available. No crawler retry or access-control bypass; four alternate source bodies were opened in the same run.
